verses.1: As he climbed down from the mountain, many people followed him.
verses.2: And when he came forward, he bowed down to him and said, “Lord, if you wish, I can cleanse you.”
verses.3: And he stretched out his hand and said to him, “I want you to be cleansed.” Immediately, his leprosy was healed.
verses.4: And Jesus said to him, “When you say nothing, then take yourself before the priest and offer the sacrifice that Moses commanded as a testimony for them.”
verses.5: When he entered Kafarnauum, the centurion came to him, asking for his help.
verses.6: And he said, “Lord, my servant is in a difficult situation at home; he is being severely tortured.”
verses.7: And he said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
verses.8: And when the centurion answered, he said, “Lord, I am not worthy to enter the house through your door. But just say a word, and my servant will be healed.”
verses.9: And indeed, as a human being, I am under the authority of others. I have soldiers at my disposal. And I say to this one: Go ahead, and he will go. Come here, and he will come. And to my slave, write this down, and he will do so.
verses.10: And when Jesus heard this, he was amazed and said to his followers, “Yes, I tell you, no one in Israel has ever experienced such faith.”
verses.11: I say to you that many will come from the East and the West, and they will be gathered together with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.12: And the sons of the kingdom will be cast into darkness outside. There, they will suffer torment and pain.
verses.13: And Jesus said to the centurion, “Get up, for I believe you can do this.” And the boy was healed in that same hour.
verses.14: And when Jesus entered Peter’s house, he saw that his grief was evident in his face, and it seemed like he was in great distress.
verses.15: And he touched her hand; then the fever broke away from her. And she became healthy again and could walk freely.
verses.16: Due to his healing ability, many demons were brought under his control. He expelled those evil spirits through his words, and he healed all those who were suffering from evil forces.
verses.17: So that what was owed by Esaias, the prophet, can be paid. He took on our weaknesses and cured our diseases.
verses.18: Seeing that many people were around him, Jesus ordered them to go away from there.
verses.19: And when a clerk came forward, he said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
verses.20: And Jesus said to him, “The scorpions have holes in their backs, and the vultures in the sky also have holes where they can perch. But the son of man will not have a head that can be bent.”
verses.21: But another of the disciples said to him, “Lord, please allow me to go first and bury my father.”
verses.22: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me. Then you will be able to bury your dead.”
verses.23: And as he entered the ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.24: And it seemed that a great earthquake happened in the sea, so that the ship was covered by the waves; it remained stuck there, unable to move.
verses.25: And when they came to him, they said, “Lord, have mercy on us; we will be saved.”
verses.26: And he said to them, “What kind of cowards are you, so untrustworthy?” Then he raised his voice against the winds and the sea. And great peace was brought about.
verses.27: And the people were amazed, saying, “This is Potiphar! For even the winds and the sea obey him.”
verses.28: And when he went beyond to the land of the Gadarians, two demonized people came out of the tombs and attacked him. They were so terrifying that it was impossible to go through that path at all.
verses.29: And they cried out, “What is this for us and for you, son of God? Have you come here to torment us in advance?”
verses.30: And there were also many sheep that lived far away from them.
verses.31: But the demons called out to him, saying, “If you really want to send us away, then let us go to the slaughter of the sheep.”
verses.32: And he said to them, “Go ahead.” Those who left went into the cattle pens. And behold, all the soldiers rushed towards the sea. They died in the water.
verses.33: But the boars fled. When they arrived at the city, they told everyone about the possessed people.
verses.34: And behold, all the city went out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they asked him to stay away from their hills.
